hero.h1: Roofing Company in Wichita, KS — ICT Roofing & Exteriors
hero.sub: We're Juan, Brady and Arturo. We replace and repair roofs in Wichita, and after hail we meet your insurance adjuster and push for the full roof the damage calls for. Your roof inspection is free.

sections.quote: Juan, Brady and Arturo with ICT Roofing and Exteriors are exceptional! … Hands off approach on my end with their team handling all the details.
sections.name: Jon B.

sections.heading: Juan, Brady and Arturo Run Your Job
body: **Juan owns the company and walks your roof himself.** Brady handles insurance claims and meets your adjuster. Arturo, our Project Manager, coordinates the work from the first walk-through to the last cleanup.

image.alt: Dark shingle roof ridge on a two-story Wichita home against an overcast sky

sections.quote: Both he and owner Juan came personally to double check work and quality and even went the extra mile to fix a few shingles that weren’t in the original scope.
sections.name: Ryan K.

sections.heading: After Hail, We Meet Your Adjuster
body: **We inspect your roof, document the hail damage and meet your adjuster at the house.** When the offer covers only part of the roof, we push for the full roof the damage calls for.
Roof and gutters get replaced together, so one crew handles the whole storm. [See how a hail claim goes, from inspection to new roof.](/roof-replacement-wichita-ks/)

image.alt: Roof with scattered hail bruising on the shingles and a gutter along the edge
image.brief: close view of a shingle roof edge with a metal gutter, roof on the right, open sky on the left behind the text side, no readable text, no people, no tools

sections.quote: Brady was very helpful with our insurance claim and met with the adjuster. He was thorough and in for the long fight.
sections.name: Louise P.

sections.heading: Repairs, With a Straight Answer
body: **A few missing shingles or a leak is a repair, and we treat it as one.** We find the cause, fix it, and tell you when the roof doesn't need replacing. [See roof repair.](/roof-repair-wichita-ks/)

sections.quote: They give you the information and allow you to make your decisions, it refreshing to not have pressure during the process. They give honest and fair pricing too, which is not always the case in the roofing industry.
sections.name: Ramona C.

sections.heading: Everything We Do
sections.intro: Roofs are our core work. Gutters, siding and commercial roofing round out what we do.

items.a: Yes. We offer free roof inspections. Call (316) 796-6722 and ask for one.

sections.quote: I met Juan the morning after a severe hailstorm on 9-3-25. He offered to inspect my roof with a drone. It showed severe hail damage. He pointed out that my gutters were damaged as well.
sections.name: Carl W.

sections.heading: A Free Inspection Comes First
body: **The inspection is free, and it tells you whether you need a new roof.** Juan has gone up the morning after a hailstorm and flown a drone over the roof to show the damage.
We walk you through what we find. If the roof doesn't need replacing, we say so.

image.alt: Shingle roof surface with hail bruising across the slope
image.brief: wide view of a shingle roof slope with scattered hail marks, roof on the right, open sky on the left behind the text side, no readable text, no people, no tools

sections.heading: We Meet Your Adjuster
body: **Brady or Arturo meets your adjuster at the house, and Juan has stood on the roof with one.** We show the damage on the roof itself, so the adjuster sees what you see.

sections.quote: Arturo took the time to meet with our insurance adjuster and coordinated all the work seamlessly.
sections.name: Dani C.

sections.heading: Offered a Partial Roof? We Push for the Whole One
body: **When the insurance company offers to replace only part of your roof, we push for the full roof the damage calls for.** Brady knows the claim side and stays in it with you.

sections.quote: He did his diligence to make sure when the insurance only wanted to replace part of the roof and with his extensive knowledge knew that was not correct he helped us fight to get it all replaced.
sections.name: Kristi I.

sections.heading: Claim Denied? We Help You Appeal
body: **A denial is not always the end.** We have helped a homeowner appeal a denied hail claim, and the claim was approved. Your insurance company makes the decision; we put the damage in front of it.

sections.quote: We were about to give up but these guys helped to assure that insurance saw the damage, had to do an appeal on insurances decision and YEP i got it approved.
sections.name: Crystal E.

sections.heading: Roof and Gutters in One Job
body: **Hail hits gutters too, so we replace roof and gutters together.** One call covers the whole edge of your house.

image.alt: New seamless gutter running along the edge of a new roof
image.brief: new gutter along the eave of a new shingle roof, roof edge on the right, calm sky on the left behind the text side, no readable text, no people, no tools

sections.quote: We had our roof and gutters damaged in a hail storm and ICT made our house look better than when it was new.
sections.name: Ryan R.

items.title: Old roof comes off, hidden problems get fixed
items.text: We pull the old shingles and fix what was under them, not cover it. We have found missing valley seals on a tear-off and sealed them before they leaked.

items.title: The new roof goes on, often in one day
items.text: We have put on whole roofs in a single day, and one in about seven hours.

items.title: A magnetic sweep finishes the yard
items.text: We run a magnetic tool over your yard to catch stray nails.

sections.quote: I loved the magnetic tool they used in my yard to make sure there were no roofing nails left behind. I have found zero remnants.
sections.name: Shelly T.

sections.heading: Shingle, Shake, Metal or Composite
body: **We work with all roofing systems and brands.** That includes Presidential Shake, wood shake, metal and CeDUR composite shake, and we give you our opinion on which fits your house.

sections.quote: They came out to inspect the roof and walked you through what they saw. Then after asking questions to understand what I was looking for in my roof, they offered their professional opinion on what direction I should go.
sections.name: Alex M.

items.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
items.a: We have finished whole roofs in a single day. Your roof's size and the weather set your schedule.

items.q: Will insurance pay for my new roof?
items.a: That is between you, your policy and your insurance company. We document the damage, meet your adjuster and push for the full roof the damage calls for.
Yes, and after hail we often do it in the same job as the roof.

sections.heading: Hail on Your Roof?
sections.text: Call (316) 796-6722 for a free roof inspection. Brady or Arturo will meet your adjuster when the time comes.

hero.h1: Roof Repair in Wichita, KS — ICT Roofing & Exteriors
hero.sub: Blown-off shingles, a leak in the garage, flashing that was never done right: we find the cause and fix it. The roof inspection is free, and if your roof doesn't need replacing, we tell you.

image.alt: Shingle roof with a freshly repaired patch near a chimney
image.brief: shingle roof with a neatly repaired section beside a brick chimney, roof on the right, calm sky on the left behind the text side, no readable text, no people, no tools

sections.quote: After leaving a voicemail that the wind had blown off some shingles, I was called back the same day! We set a date and time for the estimate, and again he was punctual, clean, and professional. The repair was made as agreed upon.
sections.name: Stephen P.

sections.heading: Wind Takes Shingles, We Put Them Back
body: **Shingles blown off in a windstorm are a quick fix.** We have replaced a wind-stripped section in two days.
Call or leave a voicemail, and we set a time to look.

image.alt: Shingle roof slope with a few shingles newly replaced after wind
image.brief: shingle roof slope with a small section of newer shingles, roof on the right, open sky on the left behind the text side, no readable text, no people, no tools

sections.quote: We lost several shingles from the strong winds last week and I wanted to get them replaced quickly. Juan and his team were quick to respond to our needs and had them replaced in just two days time.
sections.name: Matthew P.

sections.heading: A Leak Has a Cause
body: **We trace a leak to what is causing it, not just the spot where it shows.** We have come back to a garage leak that outlasted the first repair, found flashing that was put on wrong and fixed it.

sections.quote: They returned and did a thorough investigation of the area and found the original roofer didn’t install the flashing correctly so they returned with material to fix that and we haven’t had anymore leaks.
sections.name: Vicky S.

sections.heading: Flashing and Small Repairs
body: **Porch roofs, flashing and small repairs get the same attention as a whole roof.** We look, we quote, and we do the work as agreed.

sections.quote: I needed flashing on my porch roof and a small repair and Juan hustled and came out and did it that weekend. His estimate was reasonable and the quality of work was good!
sections.name: EB B.

sections.heading: Repair, or Replace? We Tell You Straight
body: **If a repair will hold, we do the repair.** If hail has damaged most of the roof, a patch won't hold, and we say that too. Then the better path is a claim and a new roof. [See roof replacement.](/roof-replacement-wichita-ks/)

sections.quote: Brady and his team came out quickly after a wind storm to check out my roof. They were super professional and went above and beyond fixing a few extra things they noticed at no extra cost. … Brady didn’t try to upsell me on anything.
sections.name: Thu K.

sections.heading: We Follow Up
body: **We check back after the work.** We have called customers months later to ask whether the repair or the new roof is holding, and we have replaced a rain cap that high winds blew off.

sections.quote: They also followed up months later to verify if there were any issues or concerns with replacement roof and repairs; subsequently it was the same time as high winds and the rain cap blew off and was damaged. They provided a replacement and installed.
sections.name: Edward C.

footer.about: ICT Roofing & Exteriors is a locally owned Wichita roofing company. Juan, Brady and Arturo replace and repair roofs, meet your insurance adjuster after hail, and handle gutters and siding.
why: Roof and gutters in one job

Your customers already make your case. You hold a 4.9 on 74 Google reviews. "Juan and Brady are amazing. They kept me informed at all times through the process and were extremely knowledgeable about insurance."
Your website hides all of it. Every browser tab reads "Your Site Title", no page has a headline, and the Roofing button on your homepage opens a hotel page with rooms at $100 to $400 a night.
So we built this site around what your customers say.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Roofing Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page: what your site does today, and what we changed.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The page Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: Every browser tab says "Your Site Title", so Google can't tell you're a roofing company in Wichita.
The big line at the top, "Built on Integrity, Backed by Experience.", never says roofing or Wichita.
None of your Google reviews appear on the page; the few testimonials have no names.
fixes: A headline that says roofing company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Your name in the browser tab and Juan, Brady and Arturo introduced by name.
Real reviews from your customers, each beside the point it proves.
cards.alsoAdd: Hourly speed monitoring that keeps your site fast for visitors on phones, and speed is something Google uses to rank you.

cards.title: Roof Replacement
cards.why: Replacement and hail claims are the heart of your reviews, and they have no page.
problems: The Roofing "Learn More" button opens a hotel page with rooms at $100 to $400 a night.
No page covers roof replacement, hail claims or meeting the adjuster; Services is one short list of shingle types.
fixes: A full page for roof replacement in Wichita, KS: free inspection, meeting the adjuster, partial and denied claims, roof and gutters together.
Reviews on drone inspections, fighting for the whole roof and the nail sweep, each beside its point.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

cards.title: Roof Repair
cards.why: Wind damage and leaks bring calls all year, and they have no page.
problems: Repair is one line on the Services page, so nobody searching "roof repair Wichita KS" lands on you.
fixes: A page for roof repair in Wichita, KS: wind-blown shingles, leaks traced to flashing, and a straight repair-or-replace answer.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where a ready customer reaches Juan, Brady or Arturo.
problems: The "About" button opens the insurance page, so no page says who Juan, Brady and Arturo are.
fixes: Both numbers one tap away, with your address and your team named.
A short list of what to have ready before you call.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

onboardingQuestions: Juan's surname and how he wants to be introduced (the site says "Founder"; Juan Avila-Lopez appears on the contact page). Brady's surname (reviews say Potter) and title.
Which phone number should lead, and does Arturo's (316) 807-8848 stay on the site as a second number?
Address to show: 3500 N Rock Rd, Bldg. 1800 matches Google and the site; a directory lists 421 E 3rd St N. Which is current?
Is Juan the owner of record, and are there other owners? Independent or franchise?
Manufacturer status: Owens Corning lists you with no tier, and GAF, CertainTeed, IKO, Malarkey and Atlas could not be checked. Which are you certified or preferred with?
BBB: the site says accredited but no profile was found. Accredited? Rating?
License and registration numbers in the site footer (State License #23-008038, Registration #11405): current, and may we show them?
Warranty and financing: do you offer either, and on what terms? (Neither is on the site, so neither is on this demo.)
Founding year and years in business (the site says "more than a decade" about exteriors).
Commercial roofing: what kinds of buildings, and is it a page of its own?
Gutters and siding: confirm both, and whether gutters get their own page.
Reviews mention a cedar deck restain, a fence put back up and painting. Are any of these services you want listed?
Do you want the drone inspection and magnetic nail sweep shown as standard practice?
Which towns beyond Wichita do you serve? The site names only Wichita.
Are you related to ICT Home Pros or ICT Roofing and Remodeling?
